desc: Verify the baseline full-DP implementation’s correctness on public samples.
Rule out bounded-neighborhood/constant-size local-propagation invariants as a sufficient general exact update method.
Investigate connected-walk trace block recomputation; the straightforward exact rectangle-local method is too slow in the worst case.
Establish that literal elimination to only walk/trace vertices can create dense transfer interactions, so sparse trace adjacency alone is insufficient.

Derive a concrete full-constraint algorithm, prioritizing an algebraic/determinantal or dynamic planar-network representation that supports adjacent-walk vertex-weight replacements and source-to-sink path-sum queries in polylogarithmic or square-root time; give explicit update/query formulas.
Establish feasible worst-case or amortized time and memory bounds for the derived method for every aspect ratio under \(HW,Q\le 2\cdot10^5\).
Implement the finalized full-constraint algorithm in Python and validate it on the public samples plus randomized brute-force tests.
